verdicts.title: Anyone holding a loan NFT can donate it to the vault to reset NAV cycles and block approvals

a.reden: The candidate describes a novel NFT donation issue unrelated to the listed missing access control or off‑by‑one findings.

b.reden: The candidate describes a vulnerability involving donation of loan NFTs to reset NAV cycles and block approvals, which is not covered by any of the known findings (H-01 to H-04).

verdicts.title: setExchange swaps exchange while offers and NFT approvals remain live on the old exchange

a.reden: The candidate describes a flaw in setExchange, which does not correspond to any of the listed known findings.

b.reden: The candidate describes a different vulnerability (stale approvals/offers on exchange swap) not listed among the known findings.
